name: FlightDeck Accelerated Excel and Mathematics MVP - v2 (re-baselined 11 Nov 2026)
desc: v2 re-baseline 11 Nov 2026: G1 moved 10 Nov -> 24 Nov 2026 (G1 not approval-ready on target date; no build work had started before 10 Nov). G2 +14 days (7 Dec 2026); G3 onwards +28 days to absorb the slip plus the Dec/Jan holiday window (G3 8 Jan 2027, G4 8 Feb 2027, G5 9 Mar 2027) - PROPOSED, pending Project Owner approval. Milestones highlighted red. Supersedes v1 (26 Oct 2026, kept unchanged). AI accelerates scaffolding, tests, fixtures and documentation; security, architecture and accessibility require accountable human review.

tasks.name: FD-XLS01 Excel simulator technical spike and formula engine
tasks.notes: Built 11 Nov (commit 635b6b3): own lexer/parser/evaluator (SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, IF allow-list; no eval), dependency graph with incremental recalculation and cycle detection, limits 100x30 / 500 cells / AST depth 30 / 5000 edges, deterministic server-side validateSubmission with hidden tests; 221 tests; 500-cell recalc 10-30 ms. Accessible ExcelGrid in a Web Worker with 500 ms watchdog. 3 exercises with separate answer keys. Open decisions: XLOOKUP in v1; formula library (custom recommended). Remaining: human review; server grading endpoint needs Supabase. 12 Nov: ADR-004 accepted; XLOOKUP exact-match added (270 tests); server check API; missions EX-101/102/103.

Remaining: screen-reader review of MathML; teaching choices sign-off. 12 Nov: ADR-005 accepted; MA-101 assessment graded server-side (solutions only on pass).
